items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: Will Osborne the old band leader was the entertainment director, he was a great guy. And it was Christmas time... Will Osborne you know was joking... We joked around

ctx.x: Okay well good, he was truthful then.

Yeah. Yeah that happened at Lake Tahoe. I was working there, a great group behind me too, all beboppers in the showroom at Harvey’s Hotel. Yeah. Will Osborne the old band leader was the entertainment director, he was a great guy. And it was Christmas time and what happened was one night it started to snow, we get up the next morning and the snow was over the cars at Lake Tahoe. Five feet is not bizarre. And so all the roads were closed because Tahoe’s at the top of this real winding — no easy way up there. And so…
